Lint Persistence Libraries API

Lint Persistence Libraries

The Lint Persistence Libraries provide build-time validation of named JPQL queries and stored procedures defined in JPA projects. By compiling query strings against the entity metamodel at build time, syntax errors, unknown entity references, and invalid property paths are caught early — before the application is deployed.

What's New in 2.0.0

Version 2.0.0 introduces the NamedObjectParser and NamedObjectParserFactory APIs, which replace the previous QueryParser and QueryParserFactory (now deprecated). The new API adds support for validating named stored procedures alongside named queries, and returns rich NamedObjectDescriptor results containing parameter metadata.

Modules

lint-persistence-api
Defines the Service Provider Interface (SPI): NamedObjectParser and NamedObjectParserFactory. This module contains no implementation; provider modules are discovered at runtime through the ServiceLoader mechanism.
lint-persistence-jakarta
Jakarta Persistence (JPA 3.x) provider. Uses Hibernate ORM 6 to compile JPQL queries into Semantic Query Model (SQM) trees. See JakartaNamedObjectParserFactory.
lint-persistence-legacy
Legacy javax.persistence (JPA 2.x) provider. Uses Hibernate 5 and its AST-based query translator to validate JPQL queries. See LegacyNamedObjectParserFactory.
lint-persistence-bom
Bill of Materials (BOM) for convenient dependency management of all Lint Persistence modules.

Getting Started

Use NamedObjectParserFactory.newNamedObjectParserFactory(String) to obtain the appropriate factory for a given JPA specification version, then create a NamedObjectParser to validate named queries and stored procedures: 


    NamedObjectParserFactory factory = NamedObjectParserFactory.newNamedObjectParserFactory("3.1");
    NamedObjectParser parser = factory.newNamedObjectParser(entityClassNames);

    // Validate a named query
    NamedObjectDescriptor queryDescriptor = parser.parseQuery(
        "Order.findByStatus",
        "SELECT o FROM Order o WHERE o.status = :status");

    // Validate a named stored procedure
    NamedObjectDescriptor procDescriptor = parser.parseStoredProcedure(
        "Order.archiveOldOrders",
        "sp_archive_orders",
        Set.of("cutoffDate", "archiveTable"));
